pages.text: Both drills have the same placement controls. Right-click shelves, bookcases, and racks to cycle between flush, quarter-block, and half-block depth. Sneak-right-click to rotate them. On display cases and lights a normal click changes the mount.
The hand drill is the simplest way to start adjusting furniture.
The powered drill performs the same adjustments.

pages.title: Vanilla Blocks
pages.text: Use either drill to turn chests, dispensers, droppers, furnaces, ender chests, and comparators. Sneak-use on doors, trapdoors, repeaters, levers, anvils, or retracted pistons. Turning a double chest separates its halves.

pages.title: Two-Block Joins
pages.text: Work through the instructions for $(l:bibliocraft:furniture/seats)seats$(/l), $(l:bibliocraft:furniture/framed_chests)chests$(/l), or $(l:bibliocraft:furniture/bells_and_clocks)clocks$(/l). Right-click in the air with the drill to clear a selection.
